_about: The test-links page (test-links.html) reads this list. Every build that gives Karl something to test adds or updates its entries here (see CLAUDE.md, Working with Karl). Each link is the part after the address: it opens the app on that card, level and seed, with sign-in skipped. `level` in a link is the card's saved level number, which can differ from the number on screen (Add to both sides and Divide it: link level 2 is shown as Level 1). `reset: true` clears this browser's progress first. `notLive` says plainly why a link won't work on the live site yet.

groups.title: New: Level 1 is problems, the walkthrough is a button

links.label: Home screen, as a brand-new student
links.look: Hover Solve it. Add to both sides and Divide it both start at Level 1 = their first real problems, with a small “See why it works” button by the dots.

links.label: Reload test
links.look: Hover Solve it, click “See why it works” on Add to both sides, then reload the page: you should land on the home screen, not the walkthrough.

links.label: Add to both sides · Level 1
links.look: The header says Level 1 and the first problem is x + 8 = 11. (This was Level 2 before.)

links.label: Add to both sides · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works” and it’s the numbers-only balance walkthrough. At the end it says “Now you’ve seen why it works!” with a Level 1 button.

links.label: Divide it · Level 1
links.look: The header says Level 1 and the first problem is 3x = 12. (This was Level 2 before.)

links.label: Divide it · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works” and it’s the numbers-only walkthrough.

groups.title: Lights experiment (round 1), Add to both sides

links.label: Lights · Level 1
links.look: No Guess x / Use a move buttons; hover Add to see a grey preview row, click it and type the amount.

links.label: Lights · Level 2
links.look: The same lights screen on x − a = b problems. (Other levels show the normal screen.)

links.label: Tucked · Level 2
links.look: One work column with a slim Why? column on the right; Use a move opens a Moves drawer, I’m stuck slides up a counter tray.

groups.title: Add to both sides: help fixes (Build A)

links.label: Partly cancelled: Undo first
links.look: On x + 8 = −4: Use a move, Add −5, Go, then I’m stuck. The line names the +3 that’s left and says to press Undo first, with Undo highlighted.

links.label: A move the wrong way: Undo first
links.look: Use a move, Add 8, Go (it goes red), then I’m stuck: “That move made the equation bigger… press Undo.” After Undo, I’m stuck starts again at the first hint.

links.label: x alone: help with the sum
links.look: On x + 8 = 11: Use a move, Add −8, Go. At x = 11 + −8, press I’m stuck twice: 11 and −8 are outlined and it asks the sum. It never writes the answer, and no seesaw opens.

links.label: x alone: Teach me
links.look: Same as above, but press Teach me at x = 11 + −8: all three sum sentences show and you can type 3 to finish.

links.label: Only two lights judged
links.look: Make the helpful move (Add −8): only Fewer terms and Solved for x change; the other six lights stay dashed.

links.label: Divide it: a fraction that doesn’t split
links.look: On 5x = −15: take ½ of both sides (it fails), then I’m stuck: “That fraction doesn’t split evenly… press Undo.” After Undo, I’m stuck shows the counters.
